reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific new intervention—a thin Ni interlayer on W—to solve the known problem of poor wettability and void formation in W-Cu composites. While electroless plating and the general problem are known, the specific use of Ni as an interlayer to simultaneously improve wettability and act as a diffusion barrier in this composite system is not proposed or studied in any of the provided passages.
